exampleEn: I really hoped he would help me, but he let me down.
exampleKo: 그가 나를 도와줄 거라고 정말 기대했는데, 나를 실망시켰다.
gameExamples: She promised to come to the party, but in the end, she let down all her friends.
I was excited for the movie, but it really let down my expectations.
After all the hype, the concert didn't live up to the excitement and let down the audience.
